The '''Cadma system''' was located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Cadma Conduit]], which connected it to the [[Lekua system/Legends|Lekua]] and [[Zebitrope system/Legends|Zebitrope systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] also shared its name with the Centrality's neighboring [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]],<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> through which the Cadma Conduit passed.<ref name="CadmaConduit">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} depicts a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connecting the [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]] and the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identifies as the [[Cadma Conduit]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cadma system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA" />
